title: Support Receipt and Proof-of-Purchase Handling
provenance: Authored for the RefundFlow offline simulation; this text is not copied from external services.
license_notes: Synthetic demo text; not legal advice.
excerpts: Support intake records the order reference, the payment method used, and the customer's reported incident before recommending a remedy.
Ask for a receipt or delivery photo when needed to assess a claim. Do not request payment credentials or unnecessary personal information.
Support may recommend a replacement, return, or refund for review. Communicate the proposed next step clearly and do not promise a consequential action before approval.
If the account holder disputes the order identity or the available evidence conflicts, pause the recommendation and route the case to the responsible review team.
